data.name: Muzammal
data.gender_notes: Muzammal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'z-m-l'. It means 'he who subdues', 'he who overcomes'. In Islamic context, it can symbolize spiritual victory over self and the world. The name Muzammal carries the meaning “Subduer, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muzammal usually hope their child will grow to embody subduer, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage, determination and perseverance in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Muzammal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Subduer, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzammal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: مظمل
in_urdu.meaning: ناظر ہر چیز کا اور ہر چیز پر قابض ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مظمل نام کی وجہ تسمیہ، اس کا تعلق اللہ تعالیٰ کے ساتھ ہے جسے ہر چیز پر قادر ہے، اور ہر چیز کو دیکھتا ہے، اور اسے ہر چیز پر قابض ہے، اس نام کو مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر پسند کیا جاتا ہے، اور اس نام کو Islamic ناموں کے طور پر بھی استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، اور اس نام کو مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر پسند کیا جاتا ہے، اور اس نام کو Islamic ناموں کے طور پر بھی استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुज़म्मल
in_hindi.meaning: हर चीज़ को देखने वाला और हर चीज़ पर क़ाबिज़ होने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुज़म्मल नाम की व्युत्पत्ति अल्लाह के साथ है, जो है हर चीज़ में सक्षम और हर चीज़ को देख रहा है, और हर चीज़ पर क़ाबिज़ है। इस नाम को मुसलमानों में खास तौर पर पसंद किया जाता है और इसे इस्लामिक नामों के रूप में भी इस्तेमाल किया जाता है।

in_english.name: Muzammal
in_english.meaning: Seeing and controlling everything, and being all-powerful and all-knowing
in_english.long_meaning: Muzammal is a name that is derived from Arabic roots, and it means seeing and controlling everything, and being all-powerful and all-knowing. It is a name that is associated with the concept of Tawfiq in Islam, which means being guided and protected by Allah. In the Quran, this name is used to describe the Prophet Muhammad's relationship with Allah. Muzammal is also considered one of the names of the righteous in Islam, and it is a popular name among Muslims worldwide.
